title: 第17章 难道陈怀安是天才第18章 这是很重要的东西
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
没错，这种强烈的感觉不是错觉。
甚至让陈怀安控制不住罪恶的手。
他抓住了那套银针。
看了眼隔壁的老头子，嘴角勾起一抹狞笑。其中竟有三分不羁，三分猥琐，三分傲慢，三分轻描淡写和88分迫不及待。
然后打开针套。
里面躺着36根银针，手指从银针针头抚过，一股熟悉的感觉涌上心尖儿，就好像摸的是女友的指头。
“对不住了！”
陈怀安对旁边的老头默默抱拳。
然后捏起一根银针。
反手就扎在自己腿上。
用别人用过的银针扎自己的腿。
这，对银针来说何尝不是一种ntr？
这，就是他对老头和针深深的歉意啊！
至于为什么不扎老头？
疯了吧，他只是有点感觉和兴趣使然，随便扎别人这么不负责的事情他可不会做，倒是扎自己没什么心理负担，反正他快死了，啥都敢给自己试试。
目光落在腿上，眼前有穴位脉络浮现，隐隐和游戏中的穴位图重合，他手指快若闪电，行针宛如流云拂水，眨眼间36根针头已经落满右腿。
陈怀安深吸口气，屏住呼吸。
接下来一根根调整深度，旋转银针屁股，刺激着腿上的穴位，他那平时拿瓶水都会哆嗦的手此刻却稳得吓人。
半晌，施针完毕。
陈怀安把银针收回针套放回原位。

那股骚骚的小感觉终于没了。
“舒服了。”他搓了搓手，意满离。
骨折的是右腿，他扎的就是右腿。
此刻腿上的淤血已经有消退的迹象，只有骨头还是扭曲的。但骨折本身不是一件非常严重的问题，主要是骨折后引起的组织挫伤能不能处理好，缓解淤血自然非常重要。
行针不到十分钟，却能有明显的消肿和退淤血的效果。
陈怀安都觉得不可思议。
不是，这游戏真硬核啊！
是真能学到东西啊？
不过肯定也不是所有人都能学明白。谁能像他一样做一遍就记住行针方法和穴位图呢？
可他以前记性没那么好来着。
有点邪乎啊……
陈怀安琢磨了一会儿，突然眼前一亮，以拳击掌：“原来如此，我懂了，哈哈哈哈！”
病房外，吴大夫和张大夫一起走来，还在谈论陈怀安的事。
content_en:
Yes, this strong feeling is not an illusion.
It even made Chen Huaian unable to control his sinful hands.
He grabbed the set of silver needles.
He glanced at the old man next door with a sinister smile on his lips. Among them, there are 30% uninhibited, 3% vulgar, 3% arrogant, 30% understatement and 88% impatient.
Then open the needle cover.
There were 36 silver needles lying inside. When I touched the needles with my fingers, a familiar feeling came to my heart, as if I was touching my girlfriend's fingers.
"I'm sorry!"
Chen Huaian silently clasped his fists at the old man next to him.
Then he picked up a silver needle.
He stabbed his leg with his backhand.
Prick yourself in the leg with a silver needle that someone else used.
Isn't this a kind of ntr for Yinzhen?
This is his deep apology to the old man and the needle!
As for why not stab the old man?
Crazy, he just has some feelings and interests. He would not do such an irresponsible thing by stabbing others casually. But stabbing himself has no psychological burden. Anyway, he is about to die, so he dares to try anything on himself.
His eyes fell on his legs, and acupuncture points appeared in front of him, which vaguely overlapped with the acupoint maps in the game. His fingers were as fast as lightning, and the needles moved like flowing clouds and water. In the blink of an eye, 36 needles had landed on his right leg.
Chen Huaian took a deep breath and held his breath.
Next, he adjusted the depth one by one, rotated the butt of the silver needle, and stimulated the acupuncture points on his legs. His hands that would usually tremble when holding a bottle of water were frighteningly steady at the moment.
After a long while, the acupuncture was completed.
Chen Huaian put the silver needle back into the needle sheath and put it back into place.
That little naughty feeling was finally gone.
"I feel good." He rubbed his hands, feeling satisfied.
The fractured right leg was the one he stabbed.
At this moment, the congestion on the leg has shown signs of subsidence, but only the bones are still twisted. But the fracture itself is not a very serious problem. The main problem is whether the tissue contusion caused by the fracture can be handled well. Relieving congestion is naturally very important.
It takes less than ten minutes to perform acupuncture, but it can have obvious effects of reducing swelling and congestion.
Chen Huaian found it incredible.
No, this game is really hardcore!
Can you really learn something?
But certainly not everyone can learn it. Who can remember the acupuncture method and acupuncture point map after doing it once like him?
But his memory wasn't that good before.
It's a bit evil...
Chen Huaian thought about it for a while, then suddenly his eyes lit up and he slapped his fist: "I see, I understand, hahahaha!"
Outside the ward, Doctor Wu and Doctor Zhang walked together, still talking about Chen Huaian.
